mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_agent_skill WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS id, s.skill_name AS skillName, s.skill_content AS skillContent, s.enabled AS enabled, s.create_time AS createTime, s.update_time AS updateTime FROM user_agent_skill b JOIN user_skill s ON s.id = b.skill_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.agent_id = #{agentId} AND s.enabled = 1 ORDER BY b.id DESC
